objective.text: Fill only absent nested values with data_fill without replacing existing false or null values.

difficulty.rationale: Distinguish absence from a present falsey value when filling defaults.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

files.source:
<?php

$settings = ['enabled' => false, 'label' => null];

data_fill($settings, 'enabled', true);
data_fill($settings, 'label', 'default');
data_fill($settings, 'limit', 10);

echo json_encode($settings);

stem: What JSON results from these fills?
